[{"id":"nnvMTG5Sl5","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"\ud83c\udf10Website Manual","col":12}},{"id":"B-CtTCmVDX","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The website module consists of two main features: a public website, and a user portal.","col":12}},{"id":"fAFxFk8rny","type":"header","data":{"text":"\ud83c\udf0eWebsite","col":12}},{"id":"WCW6FzkHwB","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The public facing website is accessible by anyone and can be dynamically updated based on information in the Church App (i.e. Beliefs, Missionaries, Ministries, etc).
User accounts with \"Church Manager\" permissions can modify the website by editing the website settings and publishing documents.
The website menu is the Top Bar table in Website Settings, and pages themselves are Web Page records. Removing a link from the menu does not take its page down: after you save, the app offers to un-publish any Web Page that link pointed at. Answer No to keep the page reachable by its address.
No user account is required to view the website - anyone with an internet connection and a web browser can view the public website.
The site's look is a Website Theme, chosen under Website Settings \u2192 Website Theme: Churchit (the shipped look) or Frappe's plain Standard. Each has a light and a dark mode; visitors switch with the sun/moon button in the navbar, and the site follows their device setting until they do.
Every page ends with the same short footer: the church's name and founding year from the Church record on the left; the phone number from Contact Us Settings and the church address on the right (the address opens in OpenStreetMap); the copyright from Website Settings \u2192 Footer, if set, in the middle; and the footer links from the same tab centred underneath. The Contact Us page shows that same church address unless Contact address differs from the church address is checked in Contact Us Settings, which reveals fields for a different one.","col":12}},{"id":"nZdduTPzRH","type":"header","data":{"text":"\ud83d\udc64User Portal","col":12}},{"id":"8qBfIl0adi","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The user portal requires login credentials and provides users a personalized interface for accessing church information relevant to their account (i.e. Personal Profile, Prayer Requests, Alms Requests, Function Sign-Ups, etc).
Portal users cannot access all information in the Church App, they can only access information related to their 'Person', or information shared with them (i.e. non-private prayer requests).","col":12}}]
